def check(candidate):

    # Check some simple cases
    assert candidate([1,2,3,5,4,7,9,6]) == 4
    assert candidate([1, 2, 3, 4, 3, 2, 2]) == 1
    assert candidate([1, 4, 2]) == 1
    assert candidate([1, 4, 4, 2]) == 1

    # Check some edge cases that are easy to work out by hand.
